About the club ?


The FOSS Club at SRM IST Tiruchirappalli is a community-driven initiative dedicated to fostering open-source culture and collaborative development among students.

We focus on bridging the gap between academic learning and practical implementation through workshops, flagship technical events, open-source projects, contribution drives, and peer-based learning.

Our mission is to transform students from passive learners into active contributors by creating an ecosystem where innovation, collaboration, and technology thrive together

Past Initiatives -

Every initiative contributes to building a stronger technical community. From workshops and collaboration sessions to contribution drives and technical meetups, FOSS continues to create meaningful learning experiences for students.

You can explore about past events and intiatives Here



What's Next ?

FOSS is committed to building long-term technical impact through workshops, contribution programs, hackathons, collaborative projects, and community-driven innovation initiatives.

Join The Community ?

Whether you are a beginner exploring technology or an experienced developer looking to contribute, FOSS provides a collaborative environment where students can learn, build, and grow together.
